title: Is cybersecurity back in the leadership role?

observed_trades.setup: An earlier buy that would not get going and squatted, on lighter volume than today's move.
observed_trades.quote: I bought it a few days ago and it just would not get going. It squatted on me.
observed_trades.notes: He does not say he sold this attempt, so no exit row; it may be the same shares he holds today.

observed_trades.setup: Bought strength on a 5-minute opening range break with volume sustained above the prior day, on a day the cybersecurity group gapped and ran.
observed_trades.stop: moved to break even after trimming a fifth
observed_trades.quote: I did buy some um Octa and I thought that this one was interesting because I bought it a few
observed_trades.notes: Read as a fresh buy today ('a new longs working', 'able to buy strength and it continue higher'), but the passage could also mean the only buy was the one a few days ago. The trigger is narrated in the second person.

observed_trades.setup: Booked a fifth into a massive move to new 52-week highs ahead of Wednesday's rate decision; the market has not been letting names get extended.
observed_trades.quote: Um I did book a fifth of my Octa today. Just an absolutely massive move.
observed_trades.notes: Restated at 11:25 ('I trim a fifth stop goes to break even').

observed_trades.setup: Short in the gold miners ETF held about three weeks; gapped down today to a new low of the recent consolidation.
observed_trades.quote: I've been incredibly patient with GDX shorting it on the 26. So about three weeks in this thing
observed_trades.notes: 'The 26' with 'about three weeks in' = August 26. Still open (04:45: 'I have a short in GDX').

observed_trades.setup: Still holding through a three-week sideways consolidation after a 30-some percent move; he is sitting on cash so sees no reason to cut it.
observed_trades.stop: plan is to keep it so long as it is above the 200-day
observed_trades.quote: And I continued to hold IBIT on the long side and IBIBIT had a nice little update.

observed_trades.setup: Bought the dip on the gap down as it held the 20-day; took it home.
observed_trades.stop: if no traction tomorrow, out right around flat
observed_trades.quote: I also did buy AMD on the gap down. I thought it was doing a nice little job holding on to the 20 simple moving average.
observed_trades.notes: Restated at 07:45 ('I did end up buying some AMD. I took it home').

observed_trades.setup: Intraday attempt that did not close well enough to keep.
observed_trades.quote: I also tried SPCX um on the intraday and it just did not
observed_trades.notes: Failed attempt; see the exit row.

observed_trades.setup: Let it go on the weak close, effectively flat.
observed_trades.quote: close all that well. So I let it go u effectively a flat trade.
observed_trades.notes: Ticker named in the preceding block at 05:07.

observed_trades.setup: A green trade he recounts as a lesson in paying himself faster: bought Thursday, trimmed too little into strength, out Friday.
observed_trades.quote: I I had Micron. It was a green trade, but I didn't do a good enough job booking Micron into the strength, which just kind of sucks, right? It's like you bought it on Thursday
observed_trades.notes: The buy is narrated in the second person ('you bought it on Thursday'), anchored by 'I had Micron'.

observed_trades.setup: Several small trims into strength that he says were not enough.
observed_trades.size: a little bit of a piece, then another piece, then a small piece
observed_trades.quote: took a little bit of a piece off and then you took another piece off and then you took a small piece
observed_trades.notes: Three small trims collapsed into one row; days not stated (Thursday and/or Friday). Second-person narration; ticker named at 10:09.

observed_trades.setup: Sold the remaining majority of the position on Friday; holding would have put the remainder red after today's gap down.
observed_trades.size: all of the remainder (the majority of the position)
observed_trades.quote: you didn't take enough off and then um I took it all off on Friday.
